brief.title: Kitchen fractions for a 9-year-old
brief.goal: Halves, quarters and eighths of a real object, taught at the kitchen table with a knife and a measuring cup. The parent demonstrates, the child explains what they did.
brief.starting_point: Counts to 100, reads a recipe with help, knows what a half looks like on a clock.
exclusions: no knife work by the child
brief.supervision: An adult holds the knife; the child places pieces and explains each cut.

objectives.title: Name the parts: half, quarter and eighth (kitchen table)
Explain that fair shares must be equal in size
Cut a soft food into halves and then quarters with a table knife
Measure half, quarter and eighth of a cup
Explain the steps they took, in order
Apply halves and quarters to a new food or a small set of objects
